Wellbeing Nutrition is revolutionising the nutraceutical industry by providing high-quality, science-backed supplements and wellness products directly to consumers. - Analyse funnel drop-offs and suggest fixes to lift conversion rates.

- Manage allocated monthly ad budgets across Google and Meta, ensuring efficient spend and pacing.

**Collaboration**

- Work with design, content, product, and sales teams on creative briefs and campaign execution.

- Coordinate with SEO, social media, and email/CRM teams for integrated campaigns.

**Customer Focus**

- Understand customer needs and insights to build messaging and offers that resonate and exceed expectations.

- 3–5 years of hands-on experience in performance marketing, with proven work on both Google Ads and Meta Ads.

- Experience managing monthly ad budgets of ₹50 lakh+ (preferably higher).

- Preferred background in E-commerce, D2C, Healthcare, or Nutraceuticals.

- Strong grasp of paid media fundamentals: bidding strategies, attribution, funnel structure, and tracking (Pixel, Conversion API, GTM, GA4).

- Strong analytical skills and proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets (pivots, lookups, dashboards).

- Creative mindset with the ability to contribute fresh ideas and solve problems quickly.

- Clear communicator who can work smoothly with cross-functional stakeholders.

- Experience with Shopify-based D2C stores.

- Familiarity with creative testing frameworks and marketing attribution tools.

title: Marketplace Manager

Marketplace Manager

**Own Amazon, Walmart, Etsy and Wayfair as a profit centre — not a side channel.**

**Reports To:**
Performance Head

**Team:**
Growth — alongside the SEO Manager and Affiliate Manager

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**Level:**
Senior

**Experience:**
5–7 years running marketplace P&Ls

**Brands:**
ZIPCushions • ZIPCovers

THE ROLE

We sell a made-to-measure product in marketplaces built for standard sizes. That is the whole problem and the whole opportunity.

You will own how a custom-size cushion and a made-to-measure cover get listed, priced, found and bought on Amazon, Walmart, Etsy and Wayfair — including the parts that do not fit the template: variation structures for non-standard dimensions, made-to-order lead times, and returns policy on a product cut to one customer's measurements.

You own the number at the bottom of the channel P&L, not just the revenue line at the top.

WHAT YOU WILL OWN

**1. Channel P&L**

**Revenue, referral and fulfilment fees, ad spend, returns and contribution margin per marketplace. You decide where the next dollar goes and can defend it.**

**2. Listings and Catalogue**

**Titles, bullets, A+ / enhanced brand content, backend keywords, image and video sets, variation families, category and attribute mapping. Built so a shopper searching a specific size finds the product that can actually be made in that size.**

**3. Marketplace Advertising**

**Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Display, Walmart Connect and Etsy Ads. Structure, bids, negatives, placement modifiers and budget pacing against a TACoS target.**

**4. Feeds and Operations**

**Product data feeds, inventory and lead-time accuracy, order routing back to production, shipping templates, and the operational metrics that keep an account healthy.**

**5. Account Health and Compliance**

**Order defect rate, late shipment rate, policy warnings, listing suppressions, brand registry, and counterfeit or hijacker enforcement.**

**6. Reviews and Post-Purchase**

**Review velocity and rating, Q&A, Vine or equivalent programmes, and the feedback loop from review text back into product and listing copy.**

**7. Expansion**

**Business case, launch plan and first-90-day targets for each new marketplace we open.**

HOW WE WILL MEASURE THE ROLE

**1. Contribution Margin**

**Marketplace revenue after fees, ad spend and returns — growing in absolute dollars.**

**Review Frequency: Monthly**

**2. Revenue Growth**

**Marketplace revenue vs. prior period and vs. same period last year.**

**Review Frequency: Monthly**

**3. TACoS**

**Total ad cost as a share of marketplace revenue, held to an agreed target.**

**Review Frequency: Weekly**

**4. Catalogue Coverage**

**Share of sellable SKUs live, complete and buyable on each marketplace.**

**Review Frequency: Monthly**

**5. Buy Box / Listing Health**

**Buy Box share and zero unresolved suppressions or policy warnings.**

**Review Frequency: Weekly**

**6. Rating and Reviews**

**Average rating and review velocity per hero SKU.**

**Review Frequency: Monthly**

**7. Account Health**

**Order defect and late shipment rates inside marketplace thresholds.**

**Review Frequency: Weekly**

WHAT YOU NEED

* 5–7 years running marketplace accounts as an owner — in-house or agency — with Amazon Seller Central experience that goes past the basics (variations, flat files, brand registry, case management).
* A second marketplace at real depth: Walmart, Etsy, Wayfair, eBay or Houzz.
* Hands-on marketplace PPC: you can restructure an account, set a TACoS target and explain every bid decision.
* Comfort with product data at scale — flat files, feed specs, attribute mapping, bulk edits, and spreadsheets with tens of thousands of rows.
* Numeracy about margin. You know what a return, a fee change or a lead-time slip does to contribution, and you model it before you launch.
* Clear written English. You will write listing copy, escalation cases and monthly channel reviews.

NICE TO HAVE

* Experience selling configurable, made-to-order or custom-dimension products on marketplaces.
* Home, outdoor, furniture or soft-goods category background.
* Amazon DSP, Amazon Posts, or Walmart Connect display experience.
* SQL, Python or a BI tool for pulling and joining your own reporting.
* Experience opening a marketplace in a new country.

TOOLS YOU WILL USE

* Amazon Seller Central and Advertising Console
* Walmart Seller Centre and Walmart Connect
* Etsy Seller Hub
* Wayfair Partner Home
* Google Merchant Centre
* GA4
* Shopify
* Helium 10 or Jungle Scout
* Excel or Google Sheets at an advanced level.

WHY THIS ROLE IS WORTH TAKING

* You own the channel outright. There is no layer between you and the P&L.
* Made-to-measure on marketplaces is a genuinely unsolved problem — the playbook here is yours to write.
* Two brands, real budget, and a founder who reads the numbers and will argue about them with you.

title: Growth Marketer
description:
We run two businesses. Goela School of Finance (GSF) teaches people about the stock market. Goela Financial Services (GFS) is our SEBI-registered advisory that guides clients with their investments. We already have a big, warm audience and products people want. What we're missing is one person who owns the system that turns that audience into leads and customers — so it doesn't depend on the founders doing it themselves.

That's this role. You'll work in the Founder's Office. Your job: turn new audiences into GSF learners, and GSF learners into GFS clients — as a clear, repeatable system, not a one-off scramble. You set the plan, and you're the one who makes it happen.

If you've built marketing funnels before and you're ready to fully own one, this is a rare chance to do that — working close to the founders, with an audience and a budget already in place.

**What you'll own:**

* **The lead system**
  across both brands — from a stranger's first click to a real, interested lead.
* **Our existing audience**
  — WhatsApp, email, and message sequences that turn our current list into leads and customers. This is our biggest and fastest win.
* **Paid ads**
  on Meta, Google, and YouTube — running them, reading the numbers, and making them better.
* **Landing pages, free downloads, and sign-up forms**
  — built and improved every week.
* **A simple weekly report**
  of what's working: how many leads, what they cost, and what turned into revenue.

**Your first 90 days might look like:**

* **Weeks 1–3:**
  learn our audience and our numbers, and send your first campaign to our existing list.
* **Weeks 4–8:**
  set up one clean paid-ads channel and one repeatable landing-page flow.
* **Weeks 9–12:**
  get the GSF→GFS journey running as a clear system, with a weekly report the founders can read at a glance.

**You'll do well here if you:**

* Have about 2–4 years running growth or performance marketing — at an agency or inside a company.
* Have real hands-on experience with some of these: email/WhatsApp campaigns, landing pages, free downloads, webinar funnels, and ads on Meta, Google, or YouTube.
* Are comfortable with numbers — you look at what things cost and what they earn, and let that guide your decisions.
* Write clearly and move fast. You'd rather launch something and improve it than plan for months.
* Like ownership. You do your best work when the result is yours to drive, not handed to you.

Finance, edtech, or D2C experience is a bonus, but any real consumer-marketing background works if you can show a funnel you actually ran. We care about your judgment and results more than your degree.

**What's in it for you:**

* A real ownership role next to the founders — your plan, your funnel, your numbers.
* A warm audience and a real budget, so your work builds on itself instead of starting from zero.
* Room to grow into leading a small team as things scale.
* Fast learning across two very different businesses — education and regulated advice — that most marketers never get to see.

**The setup:**

* **Location:**
  Sector 92, Noida. Full-time, in-office, with some flexibility.
* **Pay:**
  a competitive base of
  **₹6–8 LPA**
  based on your experience and results,
  **plus a performance bonus**
  tied to real outcomes — leads, conversions, and revenue.
* Do you have a great track record? We'll stretch the pay for the right person.

**How we'll measure the role**

On what actually matters — how many good leads you bring in, how many convert, and the revenue you help create. We'll review it with you every quarter. Not likes or follower counts.

description:

FinAGG Technologies is a Noida-based MSME fintech group that builds and runs cash-flow-based lending for banks and NBFCs. The group has three regulated arms: FameScore (RBI-authorised TSP and GST Suvidha Provider), FinAGG Services (Lending Service Provider under the RBI Digital Lending framework) and QCF Capital (NBFC).

The FinAGG LOS is the platform this role owns. It runs supply chain finance, GST-based Overdraft and Term Loan journeys for large private sector banks, PSU banks and small finance banks, and has processed 10 lakh+ MSMEs.

The platform today:

* Borrower-facing PWA journey plus a back-office portal for RM, Credit, Ops and post-sanction users
* Configurable BRE that supports cash-flow-based assessment models
* Pre-integrated with CKYC, GST, Account Aggregator, multiple bank statement analysers, MCA, and in-house document identification and fraud checks
* Post-sanction stack covering document generation, eNACH and paper NACH, co-lending, escrow and bank payment APIs
* Partner sourcing APIs that let third-party apps originate leads and hand borrowers into the journey

The role

You own the FinAGG LOS as a product: the roadmap, journey design, BRD quality and release outcomes for every bank and NBFC on the platform.

The mandate is to move the platform from product-by-product builds to one configurable rail for MSME credit. That rail must cover unsecured and secured products in a single journey: Overdraft, Drop-line OD, Term Loan, Loan Against Property, Equipment Finance and Purchase or Invoice Finance.

This is a hands-on role. You will write BRDs, sit with bank policy and credit teams, configure rules with engineering and stay with an implementation until it is live and stable.

Key responsibilitiesProduct strategy and roadmap

* Own the LOS roadmap across supply chain finance, GST-based OD, Term Loan and secured MSME products
* Prioritise by lender demand, revenue and reuse across clients
* Turn bank-specific asks into configurable platform capabilities instead of one-off builds
* Track what competing LOS platforms offer and what lenders now expect as standard

Journey and policy design

* Design end-to-end journeys: sourcing, onboarding, KYC, data pull (GST, Account Aggregator, bureau, banking), eligibility and offer, sanction, documentation, e-sign and e-stamp, mandate, disbursement and post-sanction
* For secured products, design collateral capture, valuation, legal and technical verification, charge creation (CERSAI, ROC) and the deviation and approval matrix
* Own BRE configuration with lender credit policy teams: scorecards, eligibility calculators, deviations, pricing, fees and state-wise stamp duty
* Define partner and embedded sourcing flows: pre-offer, redirection, status and re-login

BRD and delivery

* Write and own the BRD for every implementation and get lender sign-off before build starts
* Run change control so that scope, timelines and commercials move together
* Work with engineering and QA on sprint planning, UAT, release and production stability
* Lead UAT with the lender and own go-live readiness

Lender and internal stakeholders

* Be the product counterpart to bank and NBFC product, policy, credit, risk, IT and information security teams
* Support the business team in pre-sales: demos, solution notes, RFP responses, effort and commercial sizing
* Keep Credit, Ops, Collections and Tech aligned on what is being built and why

Compliance and controls

* Keep every journey aligned with RBI Digital Lending Directions, KYC norms, co-lending guidelines and data protection requirements
* Own product responses in lender information security and audit reviews

Metrics and team

* Own platform metrics: login-to-sanction conversion, stage-wise drop-off, turnaround time, straight-through rate and defect leakage
* Lead and grow a team of product managers and business analysts

What you bring

* 10–14 years in lending technology or lending product, with at least 5 years owning an LOS for MSME credit, secured or unsecured
* At least two LOS implementations delivered end to end, from BRD to go-live, at a bank, NBFC or lending-technology company
* Working knowledge of MSME underwriting: GST, banking, bureau and financial data, and cash-flow-based assessment
* For secured lending backgrounds: collateral, valuation, legal and technical checks, CERSAI and charge creation
* For unsecured lending backgrounds: business loans, OD or invoice finance with data-led, low-touch decisioning
* Hands-on with BRE configuration and integrations: bureau, CKYC, Account Aggregator, GST, bank statement analysers, eNACH, e-sign, e-stamp, CBS and LMS
* BRDs or PRDs you wrote that a bank or NBFC signed off and built against
* Comfort in the room with bank product, policy, credit and IT heads
* Working knowledge of RBI Digital Lending Directions, KYC and co-lending guidelines
* Experience leading product managers or business analysts
* Graduate degree; engineering or MBA preferred

Good to have

* Experience across both secured and unsecured MSME products
* Supply chain finance, dealer or vendor finance, or invoice finance origination
* OD, CC or Drop-line OD products integrated with a bank core banking system
* Time on both sides of the table: at a lender and at a lending-technology vendor
* Co-lending, escrow and bank payment API flows

* PSU bank implementations, including RFP and procurement processes
